name: agentops-pmoa
description: Clean PMOA rebuild of agentOps. Old BUILD remains reference-only.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build:packages && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:bootstrap && npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
